public_rationale: METR's July 2025 evaluation, published August 7, reported that GPT-5 failed five of six runs on one adversarial scripting task [e1]. This limited result establishes neither a GPT-5-driven intelligence explosion nor decisive closure of GPT-5's possible role in initiating one, so it cannot settle the forecast [e1].
limitations: The cited failure rate concerns one task, not a measurement of sustained, self-amplifying intelligence improvement [e1].
The claim provides no deadline or precise definition of singularity; the contract's interpretation is necessary to assess it.
The evaluation does not establish all subsequent consequences of GPT-5 [e1].
